title: Hold a plumbing licence
what: Hold a plumbing contractor's licence to carry on a plumbing business, and be registered to work as a plumbing worker.

laws.title: Plumbers, Gas Fitters and Electricians Act 1995 (SA)

sources.title: Plumbers, Gas Fitters and Electricians Act 1995 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not— (a) carry on business as a plumbing contractor, a gas fitting contractor or an electrical contractor except as authorised by a licence under this Part;

sources.title: Plumbers, Gas Fitters and Electricians Act 1995 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not— (a) act as a plumbing worker, a gas fitting worker or an electrical worker except as authorised by registration under this Part;
